1. PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY & BIO
================================================================================
Moniruzzaman Mahdi (Brand: MAHDI®) is an accomplished Full Stack Developer specializing in building robust, performant software systems and intuitive digital platforms. With experience spanning modern frontend frameworks (React 19, Next.js 16) and scalable backend engineering (Node.js, Express, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Docker), Mahdi focuses on transforming static systems into intelligent, automated workflows.

Mahdi is available for contract engineering, full-stack application development, freelance projects, and technical consulting worldwide.
